title.narrative: Enabling Environment for Off-Grid Electricity Activity

description.narrative: Benin Power Compact - Access to Electricity Project - Enabling Environment for Off-Grid Electricity Activity: Benin does not have the capital required for a rapid expansion of the nation's electric network. To accelerate the rate of electrification, an enabling environment for off-grid electricity is essential. To support this, a national off-grid electrification framework will be designed and implemented.
